title: A/P Unpaid Invoices: after Expand all, groups loaded later arrive expanded
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure more than 30 vendors have overdue bills on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
custom_steps:
1. Click the chevron button in the table's top-left header cell until its tooltip reads "Collapse all" (every group expanded).
  2. Scroll down until the next vendor groups load.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Every group on screen is expanded.

Step 2:

  • The next vendors load as you scroll.
  • They arrive expanded, showing their rows, without another click.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11531 (Story 1, Reports open in QuickBooks name order), story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R2: “After Expand all, groups that arrive later as the user scrolls also arrive expanded.”
  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S1-R8: “A/R Summary, A/P Summary, A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices show 30 customers or vendors at a time, and the next 30 load as the user scrolls down, as today. There are no page buttons. A/R Detail and A/P Detail show each bucket's first 100 lines, then load more as the user scrolls (S4-R4). Paging never repeats or skips a customer, vendor or row, in any sort.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 1 "Opening order and header sorting" (board Main.dc.html); page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

  • "Customer name order the way QuickBooks sorts ("10 Trucking" before "2 Trucking"), marked on the Customer header. S1-R1, S1-R2, S1-R4, S1-R7, S1-R8." (caption of "A/R Aging Summary opens A to Z")
  • "Each customer opens with its own arrow; there is no way to open or close them all." (caption of "A/R Collection, groups opened one by one")
